title: Umzisi okhawulezayo weTrone
intro: Kwinkundla yomlawuli onamandla, kwenziwa isicelo esingenakwenzeka, kwaye abaninzi bakhuphisana ukuze babonakalise ukubaluleka kwabo. Sekunjalo, lo msebenzi wawunokwenziwa kuphela ngumntu onxibelelwano lwakhe nolwazi lukaThixo oludlula onke amandla omzimba, etyhila umzuzu owawuza kuphinda uvakale kangangexesha elide.
clues: Ndandikhonza ukumkani omkhulu owayengumprofeti, kwaye ndandiphakathi kweqela lakhe elithembekileyo.
Bendingengomntu ofana nomlilo okanye umntu onamandla amakhulu emzimbeni, kodwa bendinento enamandla ngakumbi.
Xa ukumkani wacela ukuba kuziwe netrone evela kwilizwe elikude, ndandisazi kakuhle into emandiyenze.
Ndathetha ngolwazi endandinalo kwiNcwadi, kwaye ngaphambi kokuba nabani na aphendule, itrone yabekwa phambi kokumkani.
Isenzo sam besingengawo amandla am, kodwa sibonakalisa ukuba ulwazi lokwenyani luvela ku-Allah kuphela.
Ndingulowo wazisa itrone yoKumkanikazi waseShebha ngokuphanyaza kweliso, njengoko kubhaliwe kwiSurah An-Naml.

arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verse: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous." (27:40)
